content_sections.heading: VNIT Nagpur Project Associate-I at a Glance

rows.details: Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT Nagpur)
Intelligent Detection and Mitigation of Cyber Attacks in Information-Centric Networking (ICN)
Purely temporary for one year, extendable up to June 2028 based on performance
Rs. 37,000/- for selected through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or national exams; Rs. 30,000/- for others

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a total of 1 post for Project Associate-I (PA-I) under the ANRF funded research project in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential educational qualifications specified for the Project Associate-I post to be eligible for consideration. Essential Qualification: M.E./ M.Tech. or B.E/B.Tech with First class in Computer Science & Engineering / Information Technology / Equivalent with minimum 60% or 6.5 CGPA from a recognized university / institute. Desired Qualification: Overall good academic record, sound analytical skills and knowledge of python programming. Fellowship Criteria: Rs. 37,000/- for candidates selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, or a selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions. Rs. 30,000/- for others who do not fall under this category.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary in nature. Initial appointment is for the period of one year, which can be extended up to June 2028 solely based on satisfactory performance (maximum till project end date). The fellowship amount is Rs. 37,000/- per month for candidates qualified through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or national level examinations, and Rs. 30,000/- per month for other candidates.

content_sections.heading: VNIT Nagpur Project Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The project involves implementing an Artificial Intelligence method for an Intelligent Detection and Mitigation of cyber-attacks that ensure both data confidentiality and access control with streamlining the encryption process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNIT Nagpur Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed format available online on the institute website at www.vnit.ac.in . Fill out the application form completely with all required information regarding essential eligibility conditions. Prepare a single PDF file containing the duly filled application form along with all enclosures including a detailed curriculum vitae, degree certificates, GATE scorecard, and other relevant documents. Send the single PDF file via email to the principal investigator at [email protected] on or before 25 October 2026. Mention “Application for the Post of PA-I in the CSE Department” in the subject line of the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed candidates will be intimated by email. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear for a written test and/or interview on the date communicated through email. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The decision of the Director, VNIT Nagpur will be final in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be rejected. Only short-listed candidates will receive communication via email regarding the written test and/or interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The selected PA-I candidate will have the opportunity to register for a regular PhD program provided they satisfy the eligibility criteria for the PhD program in the Department of CSE.
